title: Briefings to Senate Intelligence Committee members and agencies

tellings.quote: to, you know, past members of Senate Select Intelligence Committee. I've provided it to uh numerous three-letter agencies. I've briefed them, given them the locations, the names, etc.

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says that between 2023 and 2026 he briefed past members of the Senate Select Intelligence Committee, the Senate panel that oversees US spy agencies. He says he also briefed several federal agencies known by three-letter initials and gave them "the locations, the names, etc." He tells it about himself, as proof that he has put his account before people in government who could check it.
